AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.

3. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

4. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.

5. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

7. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

8. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.

9. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.

10. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

12. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Simulated Flying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Cargo Handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
